cardLine: You play for the card in front of you at dawn, not the card you were dealt. Argue for who you think you are.

baker.name: Loyal Bakers
baker.goal: Put at least one Mold Spore in the oven. If every Spore is in the Pantry, keep the oven empty or bake Team Mold.

mold.name: Team Mold
mold.goal: Ruin the Mother Dough at prep, or keep every Mold Spore out of the oven.

croissant.name: On your own
croissant.goal: Get yourself put in the oven.

boulanger.name: Le Boulanger
boulanger.nightAct: Wake first. Put the Iron Cloche on any player's Role or Location card, your own included. Nobody can peek at or swap it tonight.
boulanger.cardText: Your dough, your bench, your cloche. Slam the Iron Cloche over the one card you trust; nothing touches it until dawn.

champignon.name: Le Champignon
champignon.nightAct: Wake with the other Spore and see each other. If you are the only Spore at the table, peek at one Pantry Role card.
champignon.cardText: You crawled out from behind the damp bricks to ruin the Mother Dough. Ruin it at prep, or keep every Spore out of the oven.

levain.name: Le Levain
levain.nightAct: Wake after the Spores and see who was dealt Le Champignon. They do not know you.
levain.cardText: Your jar bubbles over to feed the spores. You know who they are and they do not know you: lie for them, even into the oven.

apprenti.name: L'Apprenti
apprenti.nightAct: Peek at one other player's Location card.
apprenti.cardText: Sixteen hours on a stool and nobody pays you. You read one line of the shift log; use it to cover for Team Mold, whoever they are.

ratDeCave.name: Le Rat de Cave
ratDeCave.nightAct: Swap your Location card with a Pantry Location card or with another player's. You see the one you now hold.
ratDeCave.cardText: You pry up the floor grate and leave flour prints in someone else's room. Trade your alibi for a better one.

commis.name: Le Commis
commis.nightAct: Wake with the other Commis and see each other. If you wake alone, the other Commis is in the Pantry.
commis.cardText: You chopped side by side all shift. Vouch for each other, unless the night moved one of you.

chef.name: Le Chef de Cuisine
chef.nightAct: Peek at one other player's Role card, or at two Pantry Role cards.
chef.cardText: Under the green banker's lamp you audit the personnel files. Find the rot before the bake.

aboyeur.name: L'Aboyeur
aboyeur.nightAct: Look at two other players' Location cards.
aboyeur.cardText: The grainy green monitor shows every room. You know where two people really worked; catch the one lying about it.

sousChef.name: Le Sous-Chef
sousChef.nightAct: Swap your Role card with another player's and look at your new card.
sousChef.cardText: You ring the brass bell and reassign the staff. Whatever card you take is who you are now, even if it is mold.

tourrier.name: Le Tourrier
tourrier.nightAct: Look at one Pantry Role card, then swap it with any player's Role card, your own included. You must swap.
tourrier.cardText: You fold an unused recipe back into the line. Someone wakes up as somebody else, and only you know what went in.

plongeur.name: Le Plongeur
plongeur.nightAct: Swap two other players' Role cards, or two other players' Location cards, without looking.
plongeur.cardText: Soapsuds, steam and wet-floor cones: you put the pans back in the wrong places, and nobody, you included, knows which.

gardeManger.name: Le Garde Manger
gardeManger.nightAct: Swap your Role card with a Pantry Role card without looking. You must swap.
gardeManger.cardText: One glass of cooking wine too many. You wandered off and came back wearing someone else's apron.

inspecteur.name: L'Inspecteur Sanitaire
inspecteur.nightAct: Wake last. Look at your own Role and Location cards.
inspecteur.cardText: Clipboard, thermometer, UV torch: you make the last sweep before opening. You alone know what you hold at dawn.

croissant.name: Le Croissant Rassis
croissant.nightAct: No night act. You win alone if you are put in the oven.
croissant.cardText: Hard as a rock under the display-case spotlight, you pray for the oven. Act just guilty enough; if they bake you, you win alone.

critique.name: Le Critique Gastronomique
critique.nightAct: No night act. If you are put in the oven, the player you voted for goes in with you.
critique.cardText: Behind the velvet rope with an empty plate and a fountain pen, you judge the kitchen. If they bake you by mistake, your pen drags your vote in with you.
